build_mpo_loss: build the MPO loss function with KL bound for policy optimization using sample log probs and Q values
build_vmpo_loss: build the V-MPO policy improvement loss with advantages, temperature constraint, and KL constraints
build_mpo_compute_weights_and_temperatur: build MPO weights and temperature loss from sample Q values using Lagrange penalty and projection operator
build_vmpo_compute_weights_and_temperatu: build V-MPO weights and temperature loss from advantages with restarting weights, importance weights, and top-k fraction
